description: Get autocomplete suggestions for what someone has typed so far, in order: Wikipedia article titles that start with it (in the lang Wikipedia, default en) and, in English, Datamuse's completions. Search engines' own suggest lists are not read. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

lang.description: Optional Wikipedia language code, such as en, fr, de or vi (default en; Datamuse answers only in en).

q.description: The words typed so far, such as "electric ca".

name: data_search_suggest
title: Autocomplete a search query
